analysis.reasonEn: Maintained a wait-and-see approach for the past 3 consecutive trading days. RSI is at the upper end of the neutral zone at 58.3, but has been consolidating after rising from 48.6 five days ago. MACD histogram shows improvement but is decreasing within positive territory. ADX remains non-trending at 10.6, down from 12.3 five days ago. Volume ratio of 0.57 compared to the 5-day average indicates weakening upward momentum. Failed to break the swing resistance at $1,890,000. Consider a shift to sell if the swing support at $1,855,000 is breached.
